title: L-Proline·H2SO4: a sustainable ionic liquid as a catalyst for the tetrahydropyranylation of alcohols in water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37532-37537
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04126K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Stability Nongrum, Ghanashyam Bez
A highly environmentally adaptable and green method is developed for the tetrahydropyranylation of alcohols in water, catalyzed by an ionic liquid, L-proline·H2SO4, derived from nature's chiral pool.
